user_scope: Preserve single-wave extraction as a first-class tool; retain all nine ordered two-wave descriptors; investigate period concentration without outcomes.

configuration.resampling: not performed; each timeframe requires its own audited supplied view
configuration.clock: trading_bar_index; nominal trading minutes and calendar elapsed minutes stored separately

composition.descriptor: abs(g)<=tau => RANGE; g>tau => UP; g<-tau => DOWN
composition.strict_continuity: same epoch, shared occurrence and low price, causal order; L0-H0-L1-H1-L2
composition.primitive_pair_code: retained for all valid strict pairs
composition.qualified_pair_code: populated only if both waves in target band and pair same-scale
composition.scale_mismatch: separate qualification reason; not a tenth directional combination
composition.speed: chronological abs(s_current)/abs(s_previous); signed slope delta also stored
composition.migration_ratio: stored separately, never called raw speed
composition.speed_relation: faster/equal/slower only for same non-RANGE descriptor; numeric equality rtol=1e-9 atol=1e-12, not a tuned scientific gate
composition.legacy_Uncertain: retained as comparator; never erases the primitive pair

period_diagnostic_plan.role: descriptive duration distribution, not spectral power or predictive periodicity
period_diagnostic_plan.histogram_edges: 4*2**(i/2), i=0..16; bins half-open except final right edge
period_diagnostic_plan.population: all extracted confirmed waves before target-band or pair filtering
period_diagnostic_plan.exact_duplicate_policy: deduplicate repeated settings; same source/view/start/high/end counted once in union
period_diagnostic_plan.candidate_modes: strict interior density maxima only; boundary peaks and flat tops not promoted
natural_cluster_acceptance_requires: equal-evidence OHLC visual review and separate post-run adjudication
period_diagnostic_plan.unproven_alternative: No robust natural clusters may exist; retain a continuous scale variable.

visual_contract.bars: every OHLC candle from wave start through confirmation inclusive

execution.additional_timeframe_inputs: not admitted until exact native-view identity and clock contract are frozen
execution.source_only_CI: synthetic data only; default-engine parity, prefix invariance, nine-grid completeness and full-OHLC rendering
